descripcion: Nursery and infant school, toy library, tiered lecture rooms, corridors, teaching laboratories and specialist rooms of a university, and the bedroom, common rooms and canteen of a student residence.

categorias.facultad: Faculty corridors, study areas and registry

subcategorias.mobiliario_infantil: Low tables, chairs and high chairs

camita_apilable.descripcion: Canvas bed stretched over a frame, a hand's width off the floor. At nap time they fill the room: easy to trip over.

camitas_apiladas.descripcion: Nap beds stacked on top of each other in a corner, on a wheeled base. The stack is chest high and rolls if pushed.
camitas_apiladas.imagen: Footprint of “Stack of nap beds”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.57 by 1.33 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

contenedor_panales.descripcion: Tall, narrow plastic bin with a pedal lid, next to the changing table. Hollow when struck.

pila_lavamanos_infantil.descripcion: Long trough with several taps, at an adult's thigh height. The floor in front is usually wet.

piscina_bolas.descripcion: Foam enclosure, its rim at knee height, full of hollow plastic balls. Step in and the balls rattle and your feet sink.

tunel_gateo.descripcion: Fabric tube with hoops, lying on the floor, for children to crawl through. Soft and light: it gives when touched and shifts.

espejo_barra_infantil.descripcion: Unbreakable mirror fixed to the wall from the floor up, with a horizontal bar at knee height for babies to pull themselves up.

panel_sensorial_pared.descripcion: Board screwed to the wall at child height, with spinning wheels, bolts, beads and textures. It sticks out a hand's width and rattles when touched.

mesa_construcciones.descripcion: Low table with a raised rim so pieces do not fall off, and drawers of bricks below. At knee height; everything on it rattles like plastic.

maniqui_reanimacion.descripcion: Adult-size rubber dummy lying face up on a mat, for practising chest compressions. A low, long, soft obstacle.
maniqui_reanimacion.imagen: Footprint of “Resuscitation manikin on the floor”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.50 by 1.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

fila_puestos_informatica.descripcion: Continuous bench with a computer at each place: screens at face height, towers and cables underneath. When on, they all hum together.
fila_puestos_informatica.imagen: Footprint of “Row of computer room workstations”: a rectangle, 3.20 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Fp”.

mesa_dibujo_inclinada.descripcion: Large sloping board on a metal stand, with a rule sliding from side to side. The back edge is at chest height; the front, at the hip.
mesa_dibujo_inclinada.imagen: Footprint of “Tilting drawing table”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Md”.

caballete_bellas_artes.descripcion: Tall three-legged wooden easel holding a canvas. The legs spread much wider than the canvas: the cane or your foot meets one before anything higher up.
caballete_bellas_artes.imagen: Footprint of “Fine art studio easel”: a triangle pointing to the back: the three legs, 0.65 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

atriles_orquesta_arco.nombre: Orchestra chairs and stands in an arc
atriles_orquesta_arco.descripcion: Two curved rows of chairs with a metal music stand in front of each, facing the conductor. The stands are light and fall like dominoes.
atriles_orquesta_arco.imagen: Footprint of “Orchestra chairs and stands in an arc”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 4.50 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ao”.

cabina_ensayo.descripcion: Small soundproofed room with a thick door and a small window. From outside you hear, very muffled, someone repeating scales: there are several along the corridor.
cabina_ensayo.imagen: Footprint of “Music practice room”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

cama_residencia_cajones.descripcion: Wooden single bed with two large drawers underneath, against the wall. Open drawers stick out at ankle height.
cama_residencia_cajones.imagen: Footprint of “Residence bed with drawers”: a rectangle, 0.95 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

estante_cabecera.descripcion: Shelf of books screwed to the wall over the pillow. It is right at head height when you sit up in bed; the cane does not touch it.
estante_cabecera.imagen: Footprint of “Shelf above the bedhead”: a rectangle, 0.95 by 0.25 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ec”.

cama_alta_escritorio.descripcion: Bed at head height on four posts, with the study desk underneath and a ladder sticking out at one side. Standing up from the desk, you hit the bed base.
cama_alta_escritorio.imagen: Footprint of “Loft bed with desk underneath”: a long rectangle with the ladder sticking out on one side, near the foot, 1.15 by 2.05 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

mesa_estudio_balda.nombre: Study desk with shelf and lamp
mesa_estudio_balda.descripcion: Desk against the wall with a shelf running above it, at forehead height for someone seated, and a desk lamp. Underneath, a tangle of cables and a power strip.
mesa_estudio_balda.imagen: Footprint of “Study desk with shelf and lamp”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

armario_lavabo_residencia.descripcion: Hall of residence bedroom unit: a narrow wardrobe up to the ceiling and, beside it, a washbasin with a mirror set into its recess. The basin sticks out less than the wardrobe.
armario_lavabo_residencia.imagen: Footprint of “Fitted wardrobe with washbasin”: a deep wardrobe on the left and, on the right, the basin, which sticks out less, 1.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Al”.

minifrigorifico_habitacion.descripcion: Sheet-metal cube at knee height, tucked under the desk or in a corner. It hums on and off: it tells you where the desk is.
minifrigorifico_habitacion.imagen: Footprint of “Student room mini fridge”: a rectangle, 0.48 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mh”.

tendedero_torre.nombre: Tower clothes airer in the bedroom
tendedero_torre.descripcion: Three-tier upright airer of thin rods, on castors, open in what little free space the room has. Chest high and hung with damp washing.
tendedero_torre.imagen: Footprint of “Tower clothes airer in the bedroom”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Tt”.

maleta_abierta.descripcion: Suitcase lying wide open in the middle of the room, both halves flat on the floor and clothes half unpacked. Low and wide: your foot goes into it.
maleta_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “Open suitcase on the floor”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.50 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

guitarra_soporte.descripcion: Guitar standing upright on a tubular stand, in a corner. Brush it and the strings sound; catch it and it falls with a crash.
guitarra_soporte.imagen: Footprint of “Guitar on its stand”: a triangle pointing to the back: the three legs, 0.42 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Gs”.

microondas_fila.nombre: Counter with a row of microwaves
microondas_fila.descripcion: Counter with four or five microwaves in a row for heating packed lunches; at midday there is a queue. The doors open to the left, at chest height.
microondas_fila.imagen: Footprint of “Counter with a row of microwaves”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mf”.

sofas_u_television.nombre: U-shaped sofas of the television lounge
sofas_u_television.descripcion: Three low sofas forming a U open towards the television. You enter from the front; from behind and the sides it is a soft wall at hip height.
sofas_u_television.imagen: Footprint of “U-shaped sofas of the television lounge”: a U open at the front, 3.00 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Su”.

televisor_brazo_pared.nombre: Common room television on a wall arm
televisor_brazo_pared.descripcion: Large television fixed to the wall on an arm, tilted downwards, with its corner at head height. When on, it is the landmark of the room.
televisor_brazo_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Common room television on a wall arm”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.25 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tb”.

dispensador_bandejas.descripcion: Steel unit at the start of the line: a spring-loaded stack of trays and, above it, bins of cutlery, bread and napkins.
dispensador_bandejas.imagen: Footprint of “Tray and cutlery dispenser”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Db”.

vitrina_caliente_autoservicio.descripcion: Steel counter with pans of hot food under a sloping glass. In front, at waist height, three continuous tubes along which you slide your tray.
vitrina_caliente_autoservicio.imagen: Footprint of “Hot servery with tray slide”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Vc”.

caja_comedor.descripcion: Narrow post at the end of the line, where you rest your tray and pay with your student card or bank card. It beeps when the payment goes through.
caja_comedor.imagen: Footprint of “Canteen till”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

cinta_devolucion_bandejas.descripcion: Hatch in the wall with a belt carrying dirty trays off to the kitchen. Always running: you hear rollers and plates; its edge is at waist height.
cinta_devolucion_bandejas.imagen: Footprint of “Tray return conveyor”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cd”.
